idea-plugin.name: Dmitrii Fediuk
idea-plugin.description:
Personal IntelliJ IDEA plugin suite by Dmitrii Fediuk.
  • Copy Reference: resolves file and directory paths for CopyReference (Ctrl+Q) relative to the nearest nested module content root bounded by an outer module's <excludeFolder>, instead of walking past excluded folders to an outer wrapper root.
  • Markdown Code Fence Background: suppresses the hardcoded MARKDOWN_CODE_FENCE_BACKGROUND full-width custom background renderer added in IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3 so plain fenced code blocks keep the editor background while preserving injected language highlighting.
  • Project Path Macros: loads project-scoped path variables from UTF-8 .properties files discovered upward along ancestor .idea directories, supporting relative paths, layered overrides, and cross-variable references without global IDE Path Variables.
  • Project Roots: removes redundant nested ProjectRootEntity entries whose root is strictly inside an enclosing module content root, restoring module ownership and visibility of nested project directories in the Project Files view.
  • Local Update Source: advertises the sibling updatePlugins.xml local repository via UpdateSettingsProvider and registers it on startup in the active IDE instance when no update source is configured for df.idea.
